issues.detail: The Greek 'ποσων' (posōn) is a dative plural of 'ποσών' (posōn), which in this context refers to 'portions' or 'shares'. The Vietnamese translation 'giỏ đầy' (full baskets) adds the concept of 'fullness' and 'baskets' as a container, whereas the Greek describes 'portions/shares of the fragments'.

The Greek 'σπυριδων' (spyridōn) refers to 'scraps' or 'bits', which is captured by 'mảnh vụn', but the specific phrasing 'ποσων... πληρωματα' suggests 'portions/shares of... fragments'. The Vietnamese 'giỏ đầy' (full baskets) changes the focus from the distribution of portions to the volume of the containers.
